599:t_115:3.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Why do you give up like that!? You haven't even tried anything yet!」

599:t_115:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Some things are impossible no matter how hard you struggle. Defeating me is one of them.」

599:t_115:5.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Then I'll defeat you and prove you're wrong!」

599:t_115:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「And you'll help us, too! All humanity will face the future of despair together!」

599:t_116:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Even an outsider like you denounces me.」

599:t_116:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
「All you're doing is running away! I... don't want to accept that!」

599:t_116:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You have much to say for a temporary guest.」

599:t_116:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I... won't run away...! I'm living in this world now, too!」

599:t_117:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「The time has finally come to settle this, fake $$赤い彗星$$!」

599:t_117:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That name now belongs to me, who receives the feelings of $$スペースノイド$$s... no, all Earth's humanity.」

599:t_117:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Don't act like you speak for everyone! I, for one, won't accept you when you offer no hope!」

599:t_117:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$ティファ$$ and I want a future filled with hope! I won't let you do as you please with this world and shut that future off!」

599:t_117:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「So this boy's soul was guided by a $$ガンダム$$, too...」

599:t_118:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「You don't understand the weight of human life! You have no power to guide the world!」

599:t_118:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Do you understand the responsibility of someone who carries the world?」

599:t_118:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I've watched someone close to me face it constantly! I sense none of her sorrow or resolve in you!」

599:t_118:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「You're only forcing your own reasoning on other people and the world! I won't accept someone like that!」

599:t_118:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then I shall simply remove you from the world I guide. Prepare yourself.」

599:t_119:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「The time has come to settle our long-standing ties, $$アムロ$$.」

599:t_119:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Stop imitating $$シャア$$, $$フロンタル$$! If you're going to fight, fight of your own free will!」

599:t_119:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Heh... Quite right. As the true $$赤い彗星$$, I have already surpassed $$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

599:t_119:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I will prove it by defeating you.」

599:t_119:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What a pitiful man, unable to know who he is without using others as stepping-stones!」

599:t_119:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I could never accept that such a man has surpassed my lifelong rival!」

599:t_120:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't say my name like we're friends! To me, you're just an enemy I have to defeat!」

599:t_120:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You would ignore my very existence?」

599:t_120:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Do you feel inferior to the Colonel!? If so, you do have a human side after all!」

599:t_120:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「As expected of the man $$シャア$$ took an interest in. You provoke me just as he does...」

599:t_120:5.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Very well, $$カミーユ$$. I'll show you, too, that I have surpassed $$シャア$$.」

599:t_120:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You're fixated on the Colonel to the very end! That's your limit, $$フル・フロンタル$$!」

599:t_121:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Two $$ガンダム$$s defy me together...! Me, the vessel of humanity's collective will...!」

599:t_121:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「A vessel...! Even if a person is artificial, they can't become something like that!」

599:t_121:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「Spit out what's beneath that mask, $$フル・フロンタル$$!」

599:t_121:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then... I shall accept your challenge...!」

599:t_121:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「Don't think threats like that can stop us... stop humanity!」

599:t_121:5.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「This is no threat. I always carry out what I say I will do.」

599:t_121:6.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$フロンタル$$'s pressure is growing...!?」

599:t_121:8.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Come, $$ガンダム$$s! Humanity's future lies beyond this battle!」

599:t_122:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「If you carry something of $$シャア・アズナブル$$ within you, why do you stop humanity from moving forward!?」

599:t_122:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Because I know despair awaits there. In that sense, you, as an $$イノベイター$$, should also be eliminated.」

599:t_122:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「Words like that can't stop the future!」

599:t_122:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then try to surpass me. I do pride myself on possessing a fair amount of power.」

599:t_122:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「If you cannot defeat me, you have no chance of advancing beyond this point.」

599:t_122:5.en:
$$刹那$$
「You don't have to tell us! We'll break through you... through the one who blocks the future!」

599:t_123:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「So one who possesses $$ＳＥＥＤ$$ comes.」

599:t_123:1.en:
$$シン$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$! You dragged $$プラント$$ into a war! I'll take you on!」

599:t_123:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Tranquility lies beyond this war. In that sense, you who resist me are the obstacles to peace.」

599:t_123:3.en:
$$シン$$
「The world you would lead could never be peaceful!」

599:t_123:4.en:
$$シン$$
「The absence of fighting doesn't mean peace! A world that steals its people's happiness deserves as much hatred as war!」

599:t_124:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You, the dream of the $$コーディネイター$$s, could also be called a vessel of people's feelings, just like me.」

599:t_124:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You could replace $$レイ・ザ・バレル$$ or $$ラクス・クライン$$ as the symbol leading $$プラント$$.」

599:t_124:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「You want me... to play the same role as you?」

599:t_124:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Exactly. It is the quickest path to bringing tranquility to space and Earth.」

599:t_124:5.en:
$$キラ$$
「I... won't become that. People's feelings belong to them.」

599:t_124:6.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You deny my... no, your own existence?」

599:t_124:7.en:
$$キラ$$
「I am me. I don't live to fulfill someone else's wishes!」

599:t_124:8.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'll fight you of my own free will, to stop your twisted wish!」

599:t_125:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$!」

599:t_125:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「Bringing out such an outdated machine shows your limits!」

599:t_125:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「A vessel for humanity's collective will, a new $$赤い彗星$$... You are nothing but an image adorned with pleasant-sounding words.」

599:t_125:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You mean to call me an empty shell?」

599:t_125:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「A man lost in reasoning, who knows neither the weight of human lives nor feelings, cannot carry the world!」

599:t_125:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「Especially a man who would lose to a nobody who abandoned the name $$赤い彗星$$!」

599:t_125:6.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Very well, $$シャア$$! Then I shall prove my power by defeating you!」

599:t_125:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$! Understand that this very idea exposes how small your vessel is!」

599:t_126:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Even the woman of iron is merely a woman, in the end.」

599:t_126:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I find that vulgar way of speaking more appealing than your usual empty, flowery words.」

599:t_126:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Say what you like. You betrayed $$ジオン$$, and I will purge you myself.」

599:t_126:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You are the one who betrayed $$ジオン$$... the god of the $$スペースノイド$$s, $$フロンタル$$!」

599:t_126:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「By stopping time for humanity that went into space seeking a future, you are the enemy of the people of space! Prepare yourself, $$フル・フロンタル$$!」

599:t_127:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I've got you, $$フル・フロンタル$$! I'll shoot you down here!」

599:t_127:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$ギュネイ$$! How pathetic, to let $$シャア$$ talk you around!」

599:t_127:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't get the wrong idea! I haven't submitted to that man!」

599:t_127:3.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'm a member of $c now! My fight is my own, and it has nothing to do with the Colonel!」

599:t_127:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That $$ギュネイ$$...! So he has grown...!」
